files.name: motion-prompt-100.txt
PROMPT.md
files.content:
Please use "Split lighting" (スプリットライティング), one of the names in "Photo looks, lighting & styles".
Motion Prompt #100

What it is: Light from the side splits the face into lit and dark halves
What the sample shows: The light swings from near the front (20°) to directly at the side (90°); the shadow on the head grows from a crescent to exactly half, splitting the face down the middle.
Spec:
- Scene 1: a head-and-shoulders figure in front of a horizon at y 150 (head centre x 270, y 78, radius 29 px, no face or hair). the background drops to a darker scene (sky #E7E5E1)
- Light: from the left of the frame, angle 20° → 90° (plan at the bottom right, top-right readout "90° · ↑0°")
- Head: right of x = 270 + cos(angle)·√(29² − dy²) is shadow #33405A, left is light #FFC75A; at 90° the edge is the straight centre line
- Body (half-width 56 px): right of x = 270 + cos(angle)·56 is shadow, a strip on the left edge is lit
- Timing: the effect comes in from 0.4 s to 1.4 s, holds until 4.0 s and is gone again by 4.8 s (one pass = 5 s, cubic ease-in-out (about cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1)))
When to use it: For dramatic, tense or moody portraits.

Reference implementation (Canvas 2D, a function whose picture depends only on the time): https://showheyohtaki.github.io/motion-prompt/api/v1/en/e/100.txt
Shared helper code: https://showheyohtaki.github.io/motion-prompt/api/v1/kit/photo.js
Keep the shapes, timing and easing values of the reference implementation as they are, and change only the text, colours and assets to fit what I am making.
